title: AEF 1.0: one line of gates.ndjson
description: READER (tolerant), derived from the writer schema by tools/derive_reader.py. A gate decision the producer made when the run closed (a CLI --fail-on gate, a baseline comparison): its rule, inputs, outcome and exit code, sealed with the run.

schemaVersion.description: The AEF version this line follows, MAJOR.MINOR: 1.0 for AEF 1.0 (VER-1).

gateId.description: The gate that decided, as a typed reference.

inputs.description: What the strategy read, by name, for display.
What the decision was taken on: results, requirements and a baseline run (GATE-1).

results.description: The results the decision read; each is a line of the run (GATE-1).

requirements.description: The external requirement ids the decision answers (GATE-1).

comparability.description: Whether a comparison the gate needed was shown comparable. incomparable never yields ship.

outcome.description: ship, no_ship or inconclusive. Never ship when the comparison was incomparable (GATE-1, GATE-2).

exitCode.description: The exit code the gate ended with, from 0 to 255 (GATE-1).

decisive.description: The results that decided the outcome; each is a line of the run (GATE-1).

ext.description: Producer extensions, named reverse-DNS or with the producer's prefix. A reader ignores what it does not know; never holds a secret (ENC-19).

comparability.description: Applies when the comparison was incomparable (GATE-2).
